Dear Siemens Support Team,
We are experiencing several issues with this charger.
The OCPP connection is OK, and the charger is online in our backend, but offline in SIFINITY Control. See screenshot.
The credit card terminal is available, but when you try to authenticate via credit card, the screen just loads for several seconds/minutes and then stops. The terminal is connected. See the screenshot.
Due to reactive power with the SICHARGE D 300 kW, I tried to configure the power saving mode. When the power-saving mode is activated and you try to charge, the authentication is successful, but the charger does not start charging. Please take a look too.
Thank you for your help!
Best regard,
Felix Fuchs

additional_info.subject: Semih  Handover to ES
additional_info.body:
The charger is now back online in the SCB. The issue was traced to a bug affecting the WAN connection, which prevented the router settings from being properly imported into the SCB. This is the first time I've encountered this specific bug with the new router version, and I believe it to be an isolated incident. After re setting the WAN setup and disableing the wired WAN function the router went to normal (picture of issue is attached)
please check the issues that were provided by the customer
The OCPP connection is OK, and the charger is online in our backend, but offline in SIFINITY Control. See screenshot.
The credit card terminal is available, but when you try to authenticate via credit card, the screen just loads for several seconds/minutes and then stops. The terminal is connected. See the screenshot.
Due to reactive power with the SICHARGE D 300 kW, I tried to configure the power saving mode. When the power-saving mode is activated and you try to charge, the authentication is successful, but the charger does not start charging. Please take a look too.
